what: a stand-in convoy night with boats that strike (hand-made, not the battle's)

field.title: Two boats strike, a captor abeam (stand-in)

events.text: Escort 1 drops a pattern on Boat A.
Escort 3 fires ahead at Boat B.
Boat A is forced to the surface.
Boat B is forced to the surface.
Escort 3 picks up Boat B's crew.
Boat A is scuttled by her crew.
Escort 1 picks up Boat A's crew.

lines: Two boats struck: one scuttled, one taken.
